tests.title: Articulations
tests.description: Staccato, staccatissimo, tenuto, accent and marcato, alone and combined: their playing techniques arrive, other articulations don't, and lengths stay as written (the bridge pins Dorico's note durations to 100%).

tests.title: Basic rhythm
tests.description: Onsets and durations of plain notes: whole to eighth, a dotted quarter, rests and a tie.

tests.title: Cymbals and triangle
tests.description: Suspended cymbal, triangle and bass drum, each on its own chair through the unpitched percussion bridge: cymbal rolls under hairpins, triangle and bass-drum hits with accents, and a bass-drum roll. Each part binds to its chair's instrument; rolls take CC1, hits take velocity.

tests.title: Dynamics ladder
tests.description: Every dynamic from ppp to fff on a long note and two short notes: each note's dynamic level, whether it arrives on CC1 or velocity.

tests.title: Hairpins
tests.description: A crescendo over a held note, a crescendo over repeated quarters and a diminuendo: levels inside a hairpin lie between its ends and move one way.

tests.title: Horn
tests.description: Horn in F through the brass bridge map: written a fifth above sounding, with articulations, a slur, dynamics and hairpins. Notes arrive at sounding pitch with their techniques and levels.

tests.title: Percussion techniques
tests.description: Strokes, surfaces and modifiers through the unpitched percussion bridge, each from Dorico's own items: snare noteheads (side stick, rim shot, cross stick), rim, stick shot, buzz roll and snares off/on; hi-hat open, closed and half-open; cymbal choke, l.v. and damp; a tambourine roll; conga open and muffled. Most marks are added by hand in Dorico (the list appears when the test is armed; the score shows an "add:" cue at each).
by_hand: Bar 1 beat 2, Snare Drum: Option-Shift-Up/Down on the note until its head is x (Side stick)
Bar 1 beat 3, Snare Drum: Option-Shift-Up/Down on the note until its head is slashed (Rim shot)
Bar 1 beat 4, Snare Drum: Option-Shift-Up/Down on the note until its head is circled (Cross stick)

tests.title: Pitched percussion
tests.description: Timpani and marimba through the pitched percussion bridge map: accents, marcato and staccato, a crescendo over repeated timpani eighths, and a slurred marimba line. Each part arrives on its own instrument with its techniques and levels.

tests.title: Repeated notes
tests.description: The same pitch repeated at quarter and eighth speed, and tied into a repeat: each attack is a separate note with its written length.

tests.title: Slurs
tests.description: Notes under a slur carry legato (the last note of a slur is not checked); notes outside slurs don't.

tests.title: Snare drum
tests.description: One snare drum through the unpitched percussion bridge: a dynamics ladder of hits (velocity on the pinned curve), accent, marcato, staccato and tenuto, eighths at one level, and tremolo rolls under a crescendo and at a fixed level (CC1 on the roll base). Every note arrives at the Natural or Tremolo code.

tests.title: Tempo changes
tests.description: Onsets and durations across tempo changes: 60, 120 and 90 quarter notes per minute.

tests.title: Two instruments
tests.description: Violin and flute play different rhythms and dynamics at once; each part's notes arrive on its own instrument.
